gloss: all around; everywhere around; on all sides

definitions.gloss: all around; everywhere around; on all sides
definitions.explanation: The entire area surrounding a person or thing, emphasizing that every direction is included.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だった。
{周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone around was looking this way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}み{上|あ}げられていて→積み上げる：07920_tsumiageru⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踏|ふ}み{場|ば}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Books were piled up all around the room, and there wasn't even room to stand.

notes:
Combines ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧ (surroundings) with {中|じゅう} (throughout), a suffix that emphasizes completeness across an area. Expresses that something extends in every direction without gaps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧: enemies on all sides
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧: pitch dark all around
- {周|まわ}り{中|じゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread all around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧: the whole area — emphasizes a surface or landscape covered uniformly
- ⟦{四方八方|しほうはっぽう}→四方八方：16104_shihouhappou⟧: in all directions — more literary, emphasizes directions rather than proximity
- ⟦{至|いた}る{所|ところ}→至る所：15861_itarutokoro⟧: everywhere — broader scope, not limited to the immediate surroundings
